o.text: A derivation from Proto-Turkic *kēp- (“to swell, swollen (of belly); to become pregnant; to be arrogant, inflated”). Cognate with Turkish gebe (“pregnant”), Chuvash капар (kap̬ar, “glutton”).
Borrowed from Arabic مُتَّكَأ (muttakaʔ). Compare Ottoman Turkish متكا.
